full_mgd.theta_law: theta(V)=theta0*exp((gamma0-gamma(V))/q), with q->0 limiting power law

q_compromise.description: Separate approximation: theta independent of V and gamma/V constant; no refineable q.

qualification: Manual defaults describe EosFit, not the authors exact selected settings. Direct official executable runs and saved model files are retained separately in fes-eosfit7c.

gui_estimation.mgd_and_einstein: Manual states GUI parameter estimation always uses q-compromise for stability; user can switch to general model after refinement.
gui_estimation.qualification: This concerns the estimation workflow, not proof of the authors final fit model.

other_choices.compression: Murnaghan, Tait, Birch-Murnaghan, Natural Strain, Vinet, APL, Kumar; order where supported. Morard explicitly reports BM3.
other_choices.refinement: Each refinable parameter may be fixed or released; supplied P/V/T errors can be included in weighting; use/omit/group commands control row selection.
other_choices.data_scale_factors: Console v7.6 can refine up to ten group scale factors. For volume data Vdata=scale*Veos; scales default to one and do not apply to ordinary calculations outside fitting/list.
other_choices.reference_and_normalization: Tr, theta0, n, volume/pressure unit labels, and linear versus volume representation must match the parameter and observation conventions.
